verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with credential and OAuth2 authentication. Its stated scope covers programmatic download of report data, provisioning accounts for new hires, "and much more". That is a real first-party API, but nothing shows parity with the UI's breadth: SmartScan, card management, travel booking, invoicing, workspace and rules configuration, and approvals are all evidenced only as UI or natural-language chat features, not API operations. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of expense create/approve/reimburse, workspace and rules configuration, cards, travel and invoicing; an explicit API-parity statement or endpoint reference; independent corroboration.
